measured: Application calls and optional settings are recorded below at the cited commits.

applications.name: volter-ai/supercode (Volter Harness)
applications.client: the Chat SDK's Telegram adapter (@chat-adapter/telegram 4.39.0 under chat 4.39.0, fetch POST https://api.telegram.org/bot<token>/<method> with a JSON body, multipart form data for a file; rows marked @chat-adapter/telegram@4.39.0: are its published dist), botToken TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN from the Hermes profile's .env, mode polling; configuration read at sdk/orchestrator/adapters/chat-sdk.mjs:10,80,209

backend.call: the sidecar starts the Chat SDK: the adapter reads the bot's own user (its id and username, which a mention names)
...and, polling, removes any webhook first (pending updates kept)
...then asks for updates in a loop, each request held up to 30 seconds, confirming the last with offset
a person writes to the bot in private: the adapter shows it typing
the agent's answer posted in the chat it came from, in parts of 4096 characters at most
a scheduled job's report to the profile's home chat (TELEGRAM_HOME_CHANNEL)
a card the chat is subscribed to is done: the board's notice with the card's artifact, the notice the file's caption in MarkdownV2
...a card done with several artifacts: the files as one album of documents, the notice the first's caption in MarkdownV2
